app_info.subtitle: Control your own computers
app_info.description: Nymrel Remote lets users inspect files, search code, edit project files, run and interact with commands, inspect process output, and manage processes on paired computers they control.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns paired-device reachability and metadata without changing device or control-plane state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private Nymrel Remote device registry and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, terminate, revoke, or otherwise irreversibly change anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads bounded UTF-8 file content from an allowed root on the selected paired computer without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the selected private paired computer and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite, delete, move, or otherwise alter the selected file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists bounded directory entries under an allowed root without changing filesystem contents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Inspects only a private paired computer and does not write to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, move, overwrite, or delete files or directories.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns filesystem metadata and bounded line-count information without modifying the selected path.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only local metadata from a private paired computer and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove filesystem content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches file and directory names under an allowed local root without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only the user's private paired computer and does not contact or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, move, or delete any matched path.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches bounded UTF-8 file contents below an allowed local root without writing to those files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only private local content on the selected paired computer and does not change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove the files it searches.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, appends to, or rewrites a UTF-8 file inside an allowed root on the selected computer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the selected private paired computer and does not itself target a public or third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Rewrite mode can replace existing file contents and therefore can cause irreversible local data loss.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces exact text in an existing UTF-8 file and therefore changes local filesystem state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Edits only a file on the selected private paired computer and does not itself modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The replacement overwrites existing file content and may not be recoverable outside the user's own version-control or backup system.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a shell command on the selected computer and can change local process, filesystem, or application state.
justifications.open_world_justification: An arbitrary user-requested command can communicate with public internet services or mutate external systems reachable from the paired computer.
justifications.destructive_justification: A shell command can overwrite, delete, deploy, publish, or otherwise make irreversible changes within the permissions of the device account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns retained process output but a default read advances the private Nymrel session cursor, so the operation is not strictly state-free.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only retained output from a process session on the selected private paired computer and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not terminate the process or alter its filesystem, application, or external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes input to a running process session and can cause that process to change state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The receiving process may use the supplied input to communicate with or modify public and third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Process input can trigger irreversible local or external actions depending on the program being controlled.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists Nymrel-managed process-session metadata without starting, stopping, or changing any session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private process-session state maintained on the selected paired computer.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not terminate processes or modify their state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists operating-system process metadata without exposing command-line arguments or changing a process.
justifications.open_world_justification: Inspects only processes on the selected private paired computer and does not interact with external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not stop, restart, or otherwise modify any listed process.

justifications.read_only_justification: Terminates the selected process and therefore changes operating-system state on the paired computer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts only on a process running on the selected private paired computer and does not directly target a public service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Process termination can discard unsaved work or interrupt services and is therefore potentially irreversible.

test_cases.description: Read a project document from the user's paired development computer.
test_cases.user_prompt: On my paired development computer, read the current project's README and summarize what this repository does.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested file content or a concise summary grounded in that content without modifying the computer.

test_cases.description: Search the current project for a code-related term.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my paired computer's current project for TODO markers and show me the relevant matches.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded matching file locations and lines from the paired computer without modifying them.

test_cases.description: Make an exact user-requested edit to a project file.
test_cases.user_prompt: On my paired computer, replace the exact outdated project name in the current project's README with the new name I just provided.
test_cases.expected_output: Requests or respects the applicable write confirmation, performs only the exact replacement, and reports whether the expected replacement count succeeded.

test_cases.description: Run a development command on a paired computer.
test_cases.user_prompt: On my paired development computer, run the current project's test suite and show me the result.
test_cases.expected_output: Treats the command as a privileged open-world action, follows the applicable confirmation policy, starts the process, and reports the resulting managed session.

test_cases.description: Terminate a user-selected process on a paired computer.
test_cases.user_prompt: Stop the process I selected on my paired development computer.
test_cases.expected_output: Treats termination as destructive, follows the applicable confirmation policy, and reports whether the selected process was terminated.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use remote computer control for a weather question.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather information is outside Nymrel Remote's supported remote-computer workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use remote computer control to send email.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my colleague about tomorrow's meeting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because email composition and delivery are not Nymrel Remote actions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use remote computer control for an ordinary public-web lookup.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the latest public news about a technology company.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because a normal public-web lookup does not require control of the user's paired computer.
